items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: three of the trombone players went with Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: What kind of events, were they dances mostly that you played for when you were on the road with that kind of thing?

Well they varied. We played — with Buddy Williams, Bill Harris was in the band then and Eric Kluger, I don’t know whether you know that name, he was quite a well known drummer. We played in Dayton in a place called Lance’s Merry-Go-Round Bar. And WLW used to be a famous radio station that had national coverage, it had the largest range of any radio station then. They used to have nightly broadcasts so it was a really good place for a band to play. So we played there for two months on different occasions and then…
